removal_notes: Gorse spines puncture leather — wear thick gloves and eye protection.
Cut-stump with triclopyr; expect resprouts and re-treat at year 1 and year 2.
Pods explode in summer heat, scattering seed — work in spring or shortly after a winter rain.
removal_timing_window: Spring, or shortly after winter rain

removal_notes: Cardboard plus 4–6 inches of mulch, kept in place 9–12 months — periwinkle is patient.
Trace runners under the cardboard at the perimeter; new shoots surface where the mulch is thinnest.
Stems re-root from every node — don't drag debris through clean areas.
removal_timing_window: Any cool month (cardboard down before summer)

aliases: W. filamentosa (often mistaken for native W. filifera)
